name: New Files
about: Scrum Master 3's LIVE New Files, on demand: every file of the workspace new, changed or gone since its last RUN, every new page named; red only while an UNEXPECTED new file is open and unanswered, each by its own number (F-0001 ...). Claude Code's own files are where they are expected, never red.

facts.unexpected_step: remove it by hand, or say it belongs: write its number and why in this agent's facts "belongs" (agent.json, e.g. "{n}": "<why it belongs>"), place the agent again, then press RUN on New Files
facts.cut_step: du -sh ~/virtual_workspace/* | sort -h | tail -5 (it names the biggest folders): move the one that does not belong out of the workspace, then press RUN on New Files

fault_steps.global_config.json: ~/virtual_workspace/.venv/bin/python -m json.tool ~/virtual_workspace/global_config.json > /dev/null (it names the broken line: put it right), then press RUN on New Files
fault_steps.git check-ignore: cd ~/virtual_workspace && git status (it names what git refuses, e.g. a stale .git/index.lock: rm .git/index.lock only when no git is running), then press RUN on New Files
fault_steps.the timeout: cd ~/virtual_workspace && time git check-ignore -v global_config.json (over a few seconds: git status names the folder it is slow on; move that folder out of the workspace or into .gitignore), then press RUN on New Files
fault_steps.the program: press RUN on New Files once more; if the same line comes back, send it to a builder as a request

card.pitch: Every new file known; an unexpected one is red
